name: @wuhezhizhong/shrimp
description: Shrimp local multi-client AI gateway with agent-native CLI.
author: Shrimp contributors

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check scripts/gateway.mjs && node --check scripts/init-config.mjs && node --check bin/shrimp.js
scripts.test:cli: node --test tests/unit/gateway-service.test.mjs tests/unit/init-config.test.mjs tests/unit/package-release.test.mjs tests/unit/config-panel.test.mjs tests/unit/session-sync.test.mjs tests/integration/gateway-cli.integration.test.mjs && node --test tests/unit/clis/shrimp/*.test.mjs tests/integration/shrimp-cli.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test:codex:unit: node --test tests/unit/gateway-config-store.test.mjs tests/unit/vision-fallback.test.mjs tests/unit/claude-code-settings.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-model-catalog.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-chat-request-adapter.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-responses-writer.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-chat-response-adapter.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-responses-passthrough.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-official-models.test.mjs tests/unit/codex-hosted-tools-inject.test.mjs tests/unit/web-search.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run test:cli && npm run test:codex:unit && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:codex:catalog-write && npm run test:codex:integration && npm run test:codex:e2e
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:panel && npm run release:check
